φανερόω.shortDefinition: to illuminate, light up, bring to light; fig. to appear, make apparent

φέρω.shortDefinition: to bear; fig. to carry, bring

φθείρω.shortDefinition: to shrivel up, wither away; fig. to corrupt

φιλέω.shortDefinition: to love (like a close friend), adore; fig. to kiss

φοβέομαι.shortDefinition: to fear; fig. to revere, respect, venerate

φόβος.shortDefinition: a fear; fig. a reverence, respect, veneration

φρήν.shortDefinition: a gut; fig. a mindset, inclination, instinct

φυλάσσω.shortDefinition: to monitor; fig. to guard, keep
